تزدردوا (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرِدُوا (tazdaridū) /taz.da.ri.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# تُزْدَرَدُوا (tuzdaradū) /tuz.da.ra.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
